scope: Cross-correlation / Granger / TE between W4 closed-loop ledger (100-step active+random) and D-day EEG α-phase (Apr 28 baseline_resting_60s_filtered, 5x10s windows, 4 alpha-rich channels P3/P4/O1/O2) — partial validation only, no real-time concurrent measurement
raw_ref: #92 P1 partial variant; user requested partial cross-correlation on existing data without HW time

alignment_scheme.method: Downsample W4 100-step trace to 5 chunks (each = mean of 20 consecutive steps) to match EEG 5-window resolution. NO wallclock alignment exists — W4 was 2026-05-01, EEG was 2026-04-28.
alignment_scheme.honest_note: Any correlation is a sanity check on structural shape only, not evidence of real-time coupling. Real coupling requires concurrent LSL-synced measurement.

W4_mind_tension_summary.structural_fact: near-constant (std ~ machine epsilon × value); CLM is at active fixed-point — NO temporal variability for cross-corr to lock onto

W4_gate_random_summary.structural_fact: ONLY non-degenerate W4 channel (random branch retains stochasticity)

EEG_PLV_summary.structural_fact: monotonic decay window 1-4 then partial recovery — typical resting α drift over 50s

phase_2_pearson_5_paired._methodology: Pearson r between W4 chunk-means (5) and EEG window-means (5)
phase_2_pearson_5_paired.artifact_explanation: The identical |r|=0.7850 across mt_active / gate_active is a DEGENERATE-CORRELATION ARTIFACT: both signals consist of (chunk0_outlier, chunk1, chunk1, chunk1, chunk1) — i.e. one differing point against four identical points. Pearson against any 5-point monotonic vector then produces the same r. This is confirmed by the random-control test below (shuffled EEG_PLV against mt_5 yields IDENTICAL r=-0.7850), proving the correlation is a function of W4 shape × any-5-vector, not of W4↔EEG coupling.

phase_3_granger_TE_5_paired._methodology: lag-1 Granger proxy = pearson(driver[:-1], target[1:]); TE_1lag = binary-symbolized transfer entropy (median split), N=4 transitions
phase_3_granger_TE_5_paired.artifact_explanation: TE bits are inflated by N=4 binary transitions; with 16 possible (t1,t0,d0) cells and only 4 samples, TE>=0.5 bits is well within sampling noise (no surrogate-shuffle correction at this N). Granger lag-1 r values inherit the same degeneracy as Phase 2.

phase_4_permutation_null._methodology: 2000 random shuffles of EEG_PLV; |r| null distribution
phase_4_permutation_null.verdict: FAIL_significance: observed |r|=0.43 is well below null p95=0.88 with N=5; not distinguishable from chance

candidates_evaluated.F-PASS_above_0.5: REJECT — sole |r|>0.5 cluster is the degenerate-artifact mt/gate_active group
candidates_evaluated.F-PARTIAL_0.2_to_0.5: REJECT — only non-artifact non-degenerate channel (gate_random vs EEG_PLV) gives |r|=0.43 but permutation p=0.49
candidates_evaluated.F-FAIL_below_0.2: PARTIAL EVIDENCE — phi_random vs EEG_PLV |r|=0.16; mt/gate_active TE=0; bidirectional TE on gate_random near-symmetric (no causal direction)
candidates_evaluated.F-ARTIFACT_random_identical: STRONGEST EVIDENCE — random_control(shuffled EEG vs mt_5) yields identical r=-0.7850 as observed, proving Phase-2 'high correlations' are shape-degeneracy not coupling

phase_5_classification.rationale: W4 active branch is at fixed-point (mind_tension std ~ 1e-6); any non-zero Pearson with EEG is a numerical artifact of (1-outlier-vs-4-flat) shape. The only non-degenerate W4 channel (gate_random) gives |r|=0.43 but permutation test p=0.49 — indistinguishable from chance. Synthetic chunk-alignment across different wallclocks (Apr-28 EEG vs May-01 W4) cannot, in principle, demonstrate real coupling regardless of magnitude. Mediator-framing hypothesis cannot be tested without concurrent measurement.

H1_bidirectional_mediator.reason: TE forward (W4→EEG) = 0 bits because W4 active is constant; backward (EEG→W4) = 0 bits same reason. The non-degenerate gate_random direction shows TE_fwd=0.50 vs TE_bwd=0.19 (forward larger) but both are within N=4 sampling noise.

H2_W4_drives_EEG.reason: Different wallclocks; cannot establish temporal precedence.

H3_no_real_link.evidence: Permutation null p=0.49 on the only non-degenerate channel; F-ARTIFACT classification on the degenerate channels. Consistent with H3 but not a definitive rejection of H1/H2 (partial-data limitation).

phase_4_mediator_framing_hypotheses.verdict: Mediator-framing requires real-time concurrent measurement; partial-data analysis only sanity-checks that NO obvious coupling exists in the cross-day pairing — which is the expected result regardless of true coupling.

phase_6_real_time_protocol_spec.summary: 30-min concurrent OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy 16ch + CLM W4 closed-loop session; LSL-synced timestamps; 6 user actions (eyes-open/closed, CLM-read, mental-arithmetic, breath-focus, idle); $0; ETA 2-3h measure+analyze on user-owned hardware

verdict_summary.key_finding_1: W4 active branch (mind_tension, gate_active) at fixed-point std ~1e-6 → any Pearson is degenerate-artifact (random shuffle gives identical r)
verdict_summary.key_finding_2: W4 random branch (gate_random) is the only non-degenerate channel; |r|=0.43 vs EEG_PLV but permutation p=0.49 (chance-indistinguishable)
verdict_summary.key_finding_3: Mediator-framing H1/H2/H3 NOT decidable from partial data; H3 weakly consistent
verdict_summary.key_finding_4: Real-time concurrent LSL-synced session is the MANDATORY upgrade path; partial = framework prep only
verdict_summary.delta_vs_n1_v1: N-1 v1 (BRIDGE_WEAK_REAL_HW) tested 4-gate B1-B4 with deterministic stub-real branch; N-1 v2 partial directly correlates W4 ledger ↔ EEG ledger and confirms the stub-real B4=FAIL was honest (no real coupling visible cross-day)

honest_C3_disclosures: W4 ledger and D-day EEG were recorded ON DIFFERENT WALLCLOCKS (May-01 vs Apr-28). Synthetic chunk-alignment is sanity-check only; no coupling claim can be made.

W4 active branch is at fixed-point (mind_tension std=1.04e-6, gate_active std=1.05e-4). Pearson r becomes a function of EEG vector shape × W4 1-outlier-vs-4-flat shape. This produces SPURIOUS |r|>=0.78 that DOES NOT survive random-shuffle control (shuffled EEG yields identical r).
Only non-degenerate W4 channel (gate_random branch) yields |r|=0.43 vs EEG_PLV; permutation test on 2000 shuffles gives p=0.49 — this is chance.

Transfer entropy TE bits at N=4 transitions is dominated by sampling noise (16 possible 3-tuples, 4 samples). Reported TE>=0.5 bits would require 100+ transitions and a surrogate-null correction to be interpretable.
EEG side: only 1 session, 5 windows, 4 channels. No imag-coh / surface Laplacian volume-conduction control (per spec §6.5).

CLM side: W4 was active+random branches in closed-loop ledger; the random branch is the only one with information content — but it is ALSO the branch whose F2-fire is non-meaningful in the consciousness-substrate sense.
F-ARTIFACT classification means 'partial-data analysis cannot distinguish coupling from null'; it does NOT prove H3 (no link). Only concurrent measurement can.

Bridge-coupling magnitude observed by N-1 v1 B4 (|r|=61/1000, 5 windows × 5 gens) and N-1 v2 partial (|r|=43/100, 5 chunks × 5 windows) are CONSISTENT with one another — both small, both insignificant under permutation null. This consistency is the genuine partial-data finding.
